svg.aria-label: Cable routes: wall cavity, chassis rail, cabin and engine bay
svg.text: Cable routes: wall cavity, chassis rail, cabin and engine bay
Outside the tub: 12 V in black split conduit, 230 V in orange conduit below it on the rail web; P-clips every 300 mm.
Cable routes: wall cavity, chassis rail, cabin and engine bay
Generated by tools/wiring/diagram.py from cad/fitout/wiring.py — cable IDs and lengths
match bom/cable-schedule-v0.14.csv. Measurements still [EST] until confirmed on the vehicle.
230 V work: licensed electrician only (AS/NZS 3000 · AS/NZS 3001.2). Not certified.
SIDE — from the passenger side · 1:13 on A3
PLAN — passenger half, from above · 1:13 on A3
PE2 DO3 DO4 DO5 ALT IGN PVR PVT PVS CHB VIS VSW VIG
Chassis rail, 230 V, tub to the gap
Chassis rail, 12 V, tub to the gap
DO3 DO4 DO5 ALT IGN PVR PVT PVS VIS VSW VIG
Chassis rail, 12 V, gap to the cabin
Chassis rail, 12 V, cabin to the engine
DO4 DO5 PVR PVT PVS VIS VSW VIG
Wall cavity (between the tub liner and the outer skin): both conduits
drop from the gland plate and leave through the cavity's bottom drain
opening - check on the vehicle (measurement sheet).
Rail: conduits on the outer face of the web, 12 V above 230 V;
keep 150 mm from the exhaust and use heat-rated conduit near it.
Cabin: one sealed grommet in the floor under the rear seat.
Engine bay: up the inner guard to the start battery (F8 within 150 mm).
